verses.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.pt: Aquele que mora no esconderijo do Altíssimo, à sombra do Todo-Poderoso habitará.
verses.en_web: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is he whose resting-place is in the secret of the Lord, and under the shade of the wings of the Most High;

verses.en: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
verses.pt: Direi ao SENHOR: Tu és meu refúgio e minha fortaleza; Deus meu, em quem confio.
verses.en_web: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
verses.en_bbe: Who says of the Lord, He is my safe place and my tower of strength: he is my God, in whom is my hope.

verses.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.pt: Porque ele te livrará do laço do caçador e da peste maligna.
verses.en_web: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
verses.en_bbe: He will take you out of the bird-net, and keep you safe from wasting disease.

verses.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
verses.pt: Com suas penas ele te cobrirá, e debaixo de suas asas estarás protegido; a verdade dele é escudo grande e protetor.
verses.en_web: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
verses.en_bbe: You will be covered by his feathers; under his wings you will be safe: his good faith will be your salvation.

verses.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.pt: Não terás medo do terror da noite, nem da flecha que voa de dia;
verses.en_web: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;
verses.en_bbe: You will have no fear of the evil things of the night, or of the arrow in flight by day,

verses.en: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.pt: Nem da peste que anda às escuras, nem da mortandade que assola ao meio-dia.
verses.en_web: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
verses.en_bbe: Or of the disease which takes men in the dark, or of the destruction which makes waste when the sun is high.

verses.en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
verses.pt: Cairão mil ao teu lado, e dez mil à tua direita, mas a ti nada alcançará.
verses.en_web: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
verses.en_bbe: You will see a thousand falling by your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

verses.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.pt: Somente verás com teus olhos, e observarás o pagamento dos perversos;
verses.en_web: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: Only with your eyes will you see the reward of the evil-doers.

verses.en: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
verses.pt: Porque tu fizeste como morada ao SENHOR: o meu refúgio, o Altíssimo.
verses.en_web: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
verses.en_bbe: Because you have said, I am in the hands of the Lord, the Most High is my safe resting-place;

verses.en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
verses.pt: Mal nenhum te sucederá, nem praga alguma chegará à tua tenda;
verses.en_web: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
verses.en_bbe: No evil will come on you, and no disease will come near your tent.

verses.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verses.pt: Porque ele ordenou aos anjos quanto a ti, para que guardem todos os teus caminhos.
verses.en_web: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
verses.en_bbe: For he will give you into the care of his angels to keep you wherever you go.

verses.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.pt: Pelas mãos te levarão, para que não tropeces teu pé em alguma pedra.
verses.en_web: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
verses.en_bbe: In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

verses.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
verses.pt: Tu pisarás sobre o leão e a cobra; passarás esmagando ao filho do leão e à serpente.
verses.en_web: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
verses.en_bbe: You will put your foot on the lion and the snake; the young lion and the great snake will be crushed under your feet.

verses.en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
verses.pt: Por ele ter me amado tanto, eu também o livrarei; em alto retiro eu o porei, porque ele conhece o meu nome.
verses.en_web: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
verses.en_bbe: Because he has given me his love, I will take him out of danger: I will put him in a place of honour, because he has kept my name in his heart.

verses.en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.pt: Ele me chamará, e eu o responderei; estarei com ele na angústia; dela eu o livrarei, e o honrarei.
verses.en_web: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
verses.en_bbe: When his cry comes up to me, I will give him an answer: I will be with him in trouble; I will make him free from danger and give him honour.

verses.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.pt: Eu o satisfarei com uma longa vida, e lhe mostrarei a minha salvação. Salmo e cântico para o dia do Sábado:
verses.en_web: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
verses.en_bbe: With long life will he be rewarded; and I will let him see my salvation.
